info.title: How Upcheck Works
info.subtitle: Data sources, vulnerability detection, and categorization
info.sources_title: How We Fetch Latest Versions & Announcements
info.npm_registry_desc: Queries registry.npmjs.org directly to fetch the latest published version, release dates, and repository links.
info.deprecation_desc: When a package author or maintainer deprecates a package (e.g. request, moment), they publish an official announcement reason to NPM. Upcheck extracts this string and surfaces it prominently.
info.osv_desc: Upcheck batch-queries api.osv.dev (Open Source Vulnerabilities) for every dependency and version. This provides verified CVEs, GitHub Security Advisories (GHSAs), CVSS severity ratings, and target fixed versions.
info.cat_critical_desc: Known high or critical severity CVE/GHSA (CVSS ≥ 7.0). Requires immediate update or patching.
info.cat_security_desc: Moderate or low severity advisory present in database. Review and apply security fixes.
info.cat_deprecated_desc: Maintainer or author announced end-of-life or recommended replacement package.
info.cat_major_desc: Semver major jump (e.g. v15 to v16). Review release notes for API, config, and runtime changes before updating.
info.cat_minor_desc: Backwards-compatible feature additions and performance improvements.
info.cat_patch_desc: Backwards-compatible bug fixes and stability tweaks. Very safe to upgrade.
info.cat_up_to_date_desc: Matches current latest stable release in npm registry with 0 known vulnerabilities.
